ideas.pitch: An AI study companion that ingests photos of handwritten lecture notes and textbook pages to automatically generate interactive multimodal quizzes.
ideas.title: Gemma Vision Study Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Gemma 4 sponsor track by leveraging multimodal text and image capabilities for a focused educational productivity tool, giving it high win potential with fewer competing teams.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local-first open-weight model harness that automatically catches and patches common security vulnerabilities in pull requests before merge.
ideas.title: OpenModel Code Harness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Best Open-Source AI Project track by building a practical model harness using open-weight language models, solving a painful daily problem for student and open-source developers.

ideas.pitch: A conversational voice-controlled campus accessibility guide powered by ElevenLabs that gives real-time auditory navigation instructions for visually impaired students.
ideas.title: VoiceFirst Campus Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins the ElevenLabs sponsor track by delivering a working, meaningful voice AI implementation focused on accessibility, which heavily appeals to judges looking for social impact.

ideas.pitch: A developer tool that ingests both architecture diagrams and codebase files simultaneously via Gemma 4 to detect architectural antipatterns and security flaws.
ideas.title: Gemma Multimodal Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Gemma 4's multimodal intelligence on a technical domain where judges can immediately test it live with their own code and architecture sketches during demo.

ideas.pitch: An open-source children's storybook generator that uses an open-weight LLM for narrative generation and ElevenLabs for dynamic character voice switching.
ideas.title: StoryVoice Interactive Narrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines both open-source AI and ElevenLabs voice generation to create an engaging, highly visual and auditory live demo that stands out during judging.
